title: Evergreen Maritime Museum
geometryBasis: Native building footprint and floor-level parts, operator address, and the visually inspected Qualla north elevation and gate photographs.
sectionBasis: The museum occupies the first through fifth floors of the foundation building. The principal elevation has a multi-storey stone grid, blue-green upper windows, cornices and a taller roof form.
limitations: Roof elevations of the mapped storeys are estimated from exterior proportions.
The exterior of the shared building is represented. Interiors and street furnishings are outside scope.
Ground comes from a published derivative of Taiwan’s 20 m bare-earth DTM; fine street grades are below its source resolution.
